title: THE END OF THE WORLD
author: GOPINATH
description: Gopinath, born under a world-ending sky, grows up fearing the end, but with Mira’s guidance, he learns to live fully, face challenges with courage, help his village, and discover love and hope even in the shadow of doom.

title: Nightmare Dream
author: GOPINATH
description: Jiraiya, a grieving father lost between worlds, chases his stolen daughter through haunting dreams and parallel realities, discovering love, loss, and the fragile hope that binds every universe together.

title: A Night Between Sunset and Sunrise
author: GOPINATH
description: One night. One act of courage. Two strangers. A life changed forever. Between rain, leaves, and sunrise, hearts meet, destiny unfolds, and love quietly rewrites everything. Will you witness their journey?

title: THE KEY OF FATE
author: Gopinath R.
description: A high-intensity sci-fi thriller about Arin, a father fighting against NASA’s darkest secrets, mutated human weapons, and a collapsing world—risking everything to save his family and uncover the truth behind a key that controls the fate of Earth.
